prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: one clean photographic source image for reconstructing a single table in 3D.
Generate an entirely NEW complete photograph. Landscape 3:2. Show exactly ONE EMPTY restrained Qing-inspired Chinese rectangular hardwood table, dark zitan purple-brown wood, on a plain light warm-gray seamless studio background. No plates or other objects and no people.
Design and proportions: tabletop 1.20 m long by 0.55 m deep; total height 0.78 m. Thin rectangular plank top with a small flat overhang, straight shallow apron under the top, FOUR straight square-section legs, vertical and unbent, one at each corner. Subtle small geometric right-angle relief at the top leg/apron joints and a narrow understated edge molding; otherwise very simple. No curved cabriole legs, animal feet, spindles, extra supports, shelves, drawers, brass hardware, gold inlay or elaborate carving. This should look like restrained traditional Chinese hardwood joinery, not a French console table.
Camera: carefully chosen three-quarter view at slightly elevated tabletop height so the top, long front edge, short side, and all FOUR entire legs down to the four feet are separately visible. Avoid any overlap that hides a rear leg behind a front leg. Whole table comfortably inside frame with margins on every side, no cropped feet, no extreme perspective.
Material and light: real photographed dark finely grained zitan-toned hardwood, quiet natural irregular grain, lightly worn satin finish, visible restrained grain rather than synthetic worm-like or embossed patterns. Broad soft neutral studio light, sufficient fill to see the dark joints and every leg, very faint contact shadow only. Crisp continuous edges and natural photographic optics. No stylized rendering, cartoon, illustration, CGI sheen, text, dimensions, labels, logo, watermark, borders or collage. Keep empty tabletop clearly visible and unobscured.

Use case: historical-scene / photorealistic-natural
Asset type: 04-lautaspino, one realistic color photograph for the existing approved memory-image series. Make an entirely NEW complete image, not a composite or partial edit. Portrait 3:4 for final delivery 768x1024.
Reference roles: image 1 is the EXACT EMPTY TABLE DESIGN to place into this new scene: dark zitan-toned wood, shallow rectangular apron, small rectangular geometric corner brackets, four straight square legs, thin rectangular top. Preserve its design and proportions (1.20 m long, 0.55 m deep, 0.78 m high), with lighting natural to the hall. Image 2 is ONLY the white porcelain plate's cobalt blue dragon/floral pattern and scalloped rim with thin gold edge; IGNORE the tall stack and background in that reference. Images 3 and 4 establish the accepted realistic photographic style, Forbidden City hall, daylight and natural human skin/cloth rendering; do not reproduce their people or objects.
Scene: candid moment after a Qing court banquet in a bright palace hall, circa early 1910s. Two adult male palace attendants in restrained dark indigo Qing robes, black traditional cloth caps, dark cloth boots with simple pale cloth soles. They are quietly clearing and stacking dishes; neither looks at the camera. One attendant gently lowers a single matching plate onto one of the three stacks, with physically plausible hands; the other stands slightly to the side holding a folded plain cloth. No child is required in this scene.
Main subject: the exact dark wooden table from reference 1 at the end of the dining area, carrying EXACTLY THREE SEPARATE LOW STACKS of blue-and-white porcelain plates. Each stack has about five visibly nested dishes, about 0.28 m in diameter and 0.15–0.20 m tall. All THREE stacks clearly visible and separate, arranged across the long table with natural gaps. The table and stacks together reach about the adults' waist, total about 0.95 m. Nothing is stacked on the floor. No single tall tower and no extra fourth stack. Keep the tabletop front edge, dark wood apron and straight legs recognizable, whole table including feet within the frame.
Camera: distant observation from several meters away across the hall, natural adult eye-height, three-quarter view of the table; full standing attendants visible, enough floor and hall around them to establish distance. Table is prominent enough to read all three stacks, roughly two-thirds of frame width. One long banquet table may recede subtly behind the main group to establish the after-banquet setting, with no competing stacks. Main table shape must remain distinct and unobscured. Not a staged catalog photo, portrait, frontal lineup, close-up, or an object alone on a pedestal.
Environment and lighting: large red lacquer columns, carved lattice windows, understated gilded panels, gray stone floor with real varied wear. Bright natural daylight through side windows, luminous but controlled highlights, gentle real shadows. Warm vivid but believable colors matching the approved series. Natural optical detail, realistic human anatomy, photographed fabric weave, irregular subtle wood grain and glazed ceramic; no plastic smoothness, wormlike embossed texture, painterly speckle or oversharpened patterns. Photograph rather than an illustration or 3D render.
No text, captions, labels, watermark, modern shoes, sneakers, logos, modern equipment, curved European console furniture, white porcelain table, altered table design or gigantic stacks.
